QUESTION:
What does the `--max-parallel` flag of `pq snapshot list` do?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0106] cli | pq snapshot list | version 4.x
# `pq snapshot list`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Lists snapshots.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot list <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
| `--timeout` | Seconds to wait for the operation to finish. Default: 30. |
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |

## Example
```
pq snapshot list orders --force
```

---

[d0330] cli | pq snapshot create | version 4.x
# `pq snapshot create`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Creates a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot create <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--timeout` | Seconds to wait for the operation to finish. Default: 30. |
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would happen without changing anything. |
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot create orders --timeout
```

---

[d0717] cli | pq snapshot resume | version 4.x
# `pq snapshot resume`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Resumes a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot resume <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | Name of the tenant the command applies to. |
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot resume orders --tenant
```

[d0221] cli | pq dlq create | version 4.x
# `pq dlq create`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Creates a dlq.

## Usage
```
pq dlq create <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |
| `--priority` | Priority from 0 (lowest) to 9 (highest). Default: 4. |

## Example
```
pq dlq create orders --max-parallel
```

response.content: `--max-parallel` sets the maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Its default is `2`.
